requirement: Site changes tab re-reads /activity and shows the new turn row within 3 s after a turn ends, without a reload

oracle.invariant: The build check prints a count >= 1. The unit seam exits 0 with TAP '# pass 5' and '# fail 0'. window.__row === TURN, and li.tv-activity-event[data-event='<TURN>'] has data-source='chat'. window.__rowAt - ENDED <= 3000 (fixed build on scv2: 763, 766, 1117 ms; before #787 no row within 90 s and only F5 showed it). Main-frame navigations since SENT_AT === 0. Exactly one logged /activity request between SENT_AT and window.__rowAt; its URL contains 'version=2' and does not contain 'cursor='. The [data-total] integer is >= T0 + 1. window.__sawReading === false and window.__minRows >= N0 (the rows stayed on screen during the re-read); window.__vis === 0.
